en.name: Puff pastry, frozen
en.summary: Frozen puff pastry keeps 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F). It is sold frozen because it is raw laminated dough: sheets of flour-and-water dough with a solid slab of butter or fat folded through them, which only holds its structure while it is cold.
en.pantry: Not shelf-stable, and it must not sit out. Raw puff pastry is uncooked dough with a great deal of fat in it, so it belongs at 4 °C (40 °F) or below or in the freezer, and the two-hour rule applies once it is out — one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). There is a practical reason as well as a safety one: once the butter layer softens to the temperature of the dough around it, the two merge, and pastry that has warmed through will never puff properly again.
en.fridge: No independent timeline is given for puff pastry in the fridge. Go by the use-by date on the pack for a chilled ready-rolled sheet, and keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, unopened, until you use it. Thawed frozen pastry should be treated as a couple of days' food at most and is best rolled and shaped the same day. Once you have opened a pack, rewrap the unused sheet tightly in film, because the exposed edges dry out and crack within hours.
en.freezer: 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality — a long window, and a genuine one, because the dough is raw, low in free water and packed under film. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe well beyond that; what runs out is quality, as the sheets dry, crack along the folds and pick up freezer burn. Freeze it flat, never folded, and keep it away from the freezer door where it part-thaws every time the door is opened. Do not refreeze pastry you have already thawed and unrolled.
en.thawing: Thaw it overnight in the fridge, still wrapped, and work with it while it is cold but pliable. Never thaw puff pastry on the counter or in the microwave: the butter melts out of the layers before the dough is workable, and that is the end of the lamination.
spoilage: Dry, cracked edges or splits along the folds after long freezing.
Grey or discoloured patches and heavy ice on the surface — freezer burn.
A rancid or crayon-like smell from the fat.
A sticky, slack sheet that tears rather than rolls, usually from thawing and refreezing.
tips: Keep it flat and away from the freezer door.
Thaw in the fridge overnight and never at room temperature.
Cut pastry with a sharp knife straight down; dragging seals the layers and stops them rising.
Bake from a cold sheet — warm pastry does not puff.

faq.q: How long does frozen puff pastry last?
faq.a: 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. It stays safe longer if it never thaws, but it dries and cracks along the folds.
Pastry thawed in the fridge and still properly cold can be refrozen, though the lamination suffers. Pastry thawed at room temperature should not be refrozen.

faq.q: How do you thaw puff pastry?
faq.a: Overnight in the fridge, wrapped. Counter thawing melts the butter out of the layers before the dough is workable.

zh.name: 冷凍千層酥皮
zh.summary: 冷凍千層酥皮在 −18 °C 下可放 12 個月。它之所以做成冷凍販售，是因為它是生的折疊麵團：麵粉水麵皮中間夾著一整片奶油或油脂，而那個結構只有在低溫時才站得住。
zh.pantry: 不能常溫存放，也不能擺在外面。生酥皮是含大量油脂的生麵團，該待在 4 °C 以下或冷凍庫；一旦拿出來就適用兩小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時只有一小時。除了安全之外還有現實理由：只要中間那層奶油軟到和周圍麵團同一個溫度，兩者就會融在一起，而整個回溫過的酥皮從此再也發不起來。
zh.fridge: 酥皮沒有另外給冷藏期限。冷藏販售的現成酥皮請以包裝上的有效日期為準，未拆封放 4 °C 以下保存到使用為止。冷凍解凍後的酥皮最多當成兩三天的東西看，而且最好當天就擀好、整形完。拆封之後，沒用到的那張請用保鮮膜緊緊重新包好，因為露出來的邊緣幾個小時內就會乾裂。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 12 個月品質最好——這是一段很長、而且是真的長的期限，因為麵團是生的、自由水少，又封在膜裡。只要全程沒退冰，超過這個時間仍然安全；先用完的是品質：酥皮會變乾、沿著折線裂開、出現凍燒。請平放冷凍，絕對不要折起來，也不要放在冷凍門邊，那裡每開一次門就半退冰一次。已經解凍攤開過的酥皮不要再冷凍。
zh.thawing: 包著放冷藏隔夜解凍，趁它冰冷但已經有彈性時操作。絕對不要在檯面上或用微波解凍：麵團還沒能操作，奶油就已經從層次裡融出來了，那等於毀掉整個折疊結構。
spoilage: 冷凍太久之後邊緣乾裂，或沿著折線裂開。
表面出現灰白斑塊或厚冰——那是凍燒。
聞得到油脂的油耗味或蠟筆味。
整張變得黏軟、一擀就破，通常是解凍又再冷凍造成的。
tips: 平放冷凍，並且遠離冷凍櫃門。
一律冷藏隔夜解凍，不要放室溫。
用鋒利的刀垂直切下去；用拖的會把層次壓死，就發不起來。
冰的狀態進烤箱——回溫過的酥皮不會膨。

faq.a: −18 °C 下 12 個月品質最好。只要沒退冰，放更久仍然安全，但會變乾、沿折線裂開。
在冷藏解凍、而且還是確實冰冷的可以再凍，只是層次會受損。在室溫解凍過的就不要再冷凍。
包著放冷藏隔夜解凍。室溫解凍會讓奶油在麵團還不能操作之前就先融出層次。
